moc.chu: The path of totality of the solar eclipse of February 26, 1979 crossed only the states of Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, and North Dakota.
A total solar eclipse, dubbed the "Great American Eclipse" by some media, occurred on Monday, August 21, 2017.
The path of totality touched 14 states, and the rest of the U.S. had a partial eclipse.
Many people left their homes and traveled hundreds of miles just to get a glimpse of totality.
During the eclipse for a long span of its path of totality, several bright stars and four planets were visible.
